fichas.title: Lightning protection systems
fichas.summary: A lightning protection system uses roof conductors, conductor lines and earthing rods or electrodes to intercept lightning and keep the building within a protected zone described as a Faraday cage. The page also explains step-voltage hazards, building damage and equipotential bonding. Roof illustrations show single-pitch, flat, pitched, hipped, pyramid and northlight forms, plus a typical system and component symbols.
uses: Bond large metal parts and cables to the lightning protection system

fichas.title: Lightning protection for thatched roofs
fichas.summary: To reduce the danger of ignition from the corona effect, the page specifies metal bands on timber supports above the ridge of a thatched roof. The illustrated detail also identifies a conductor offset from the roof surface and an earth conductor.
uses: Reduce ignition danger associated with the corona effect
Carry lightning current through roof conductors to earth
